name: Sheet Pan Pork Chops with Apricots, Red Cabbage & Blue Cheese

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Line two baking sheets with aluminum paper (optional).
Wash cabbage, quarter, and cut off core. Thinly slice crosswise into shreds and transfer to a large bowl. Toss with oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small heads red cabbage
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Use tongs to transfer cabbage to a baking sheet pan, leaving the excess vinegar in the bowl. Spread cabbage out in an even layer on a baking sheet and place in the oven.
Slice the apricots in half lengthwise. Add to the bowl and toss in the remaining oil and vinegar; allow to soak in the vinegar mixture while the cabbage cooks.
Wash and dry thyme. Slide leaves off the stems; discard the stems.

Pat the pork chops dry, rub with olive oil, and season with salt, pepper, and thyme. Arrange on a baking sheet and place in the oven. Roast until pork chops are cooked through and cabbage is fork-tender (18-20 minutes).
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, bone-in
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: During the last 5 minutes of cooking, sprinkle the apricots and the blue cheese over the cabbage.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, arrange a bed of cabbage, apricots, and blue cheese on a plate and top with a pork chop. Enjoy!
